name: List survey responses for a specific survey, with question text resolved server-side so callers do not have to map opaque `$survey_response_ ` keys
description: List survey responses for a specific survey, with question text resolved server-side so callers do not have to map opaque `$survey_response_ ` keys List survey responses for a specific survey, with question text resolved server-side so callers do not have to map opaque `$survey_response_ ` keys. GET /api/projects/{pro…
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/surveys/{id}/responses/
List survey responses for a specific survey, with question text resolved server-side so callers do not have to map opaque `$survey_response_ ` keys. Each row carries `distinct_id`, `session_id`, `submitted_at`, and an `extra` block (device, browser, OS, geoip, current_url, iteration) so agents can cross-pivot to recordings, persons, or paths in a single follow-up call. For person properties at event time, follow up with `persons-get` using the returned `distinct_id` — keeps scopes scoped. Use `question_id` + `score_lte` to fetch NPS detractors and similar score-filtered cohorts.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this survey.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: exclude_archived (query) — When true, exclude responses that have been archived via the archive_response endpoint.; limit (query) — Maximum number of rows to return (1-500). Defaults to 100.; offset (query) — Number of rows to skip for pagination. Combine with `limit` and the `has_more` field to paginate.; question_id (query) — If set, only return rows where this question has a non-empty answer, and only include that question's answer in each row. Required when using score_lte or score_gte.; score_gte (query) — Filter to rows where the rating answer for `question_id` is >= this value. Common use: NPS promoters with score_gte=9. Requires question_id.; score_lte (query) — Filter to rows where the rating answer for `question_id` is <= this value. Common use: NPS detractors with score_lte=6. Requires question_id.; since (query) — Only return responses submitted on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.; until (query) — Only return responses submitted on or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

name: Summarize survey responses
description: Summarize survey responses Summarize survey responses. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/surveys/{id}/summarize_responses/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/surveys/{id}/summarize_responses/
Summarize survey responses. When `question_index` or `question_id` is provided, returns a per-question theme summary using cached `survey.question_summaries` when fresh. When neither is provided, returns the survey-wide headline summary (delegates to summary_headline). Pass `force_refresh=true` in the body to bypass caches.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this survey.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: question_id (query) — Question UUID. Preferred over question_index — stable across question edits.; question_index (query) — Zero-based question index. Omit to get the survey-wide headline instead.; body (body)
